data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: Open-PR check uses 3-tier fallback chain enumerating BOTH main PR AND sub-PRs.
- DD5: Unit tests for all new/modified logic.

## Implementation Notes

Create `tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh` covering the library at `plugins/dso/scripts/lib/worktree-removal-guards.sh` (which T2 will create).

Test cases (Given / When / Then; all fail RED until T2):

**Protected branch guard**:
- Given branch = 'main' → guard fires (refusal)
- Given branch = 'master' → guard fires
- Given branch = 'develop' → guard fires
- Given branch = 'release/v1.2.3' → guard fires (release/* glob)
- Given branch = 'session/abc' → guard does NOT fire

**Uncommitted/unpushed guard**:
- Given worktree with modified file (uncommitted) → guard fires
- Given worktree with committed-but-unpushed commits → guard fires (use 'git log @{u}..' check)
- Given worktree with clean tree, all pushed → guard does NOT fire

**Open-PR-with-CI guard (3-tier fallback)**:
- Tier 1: gh pr list --head <branch> --state open returns 1 → guard fires; PR URL captured
- Tier 1 returns 0; Tier 2 (gh api commits/<sha>/pulls open) returns 1 → guard fires
- Tiers 1+2 return 0; Tier 3 (gh pr list --search 'head:<branch>') returns 1 → guard fires
- All 3 tiers return 0 → guard does NOT fire
- Sub-PR enumeration: tier 1 finds 2 open PRs (main + sub-PR) → guard fires; refusal lists BOTH PR URLs

**assert_worktree_removable orchestrator**:
- Any single guard firing → exit non-zero, refusal message identifies WHICH guard
- --force flag → guards still RUN, refusal message + PR URL still print, exit code 0

Tests use mocked `gh` and `git` commands via PATH manipulation or function override. Pattern: source library with `_GUARDS_SOURCE_ONLY=1` flag (analogous to `_CLAUDE_SAFE_SOURCE_ONLY` in claude-safe).

Add `.test-index` RED marker `[test_worktree_removal_guards]`.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|-------------|--------|-------|-------|
| `tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh` | create | (this IS the test) | needs-creation |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | marker |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Test file exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh
- [ ] Test covers all 3 guards + 3-tier fallback + --force bypass
  Verify: grep -cE 'protected|uncommitted|open.PR|--force|tier' tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh | awk '{exit (\$1>=5?0:1)}'
- [ ] Test is initially RED (library doesn't exist)
  Verify: ! bash tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker
  Verify: grep '\[test_worktree_removal_guards\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); on 3 failures escalate to opus; on 3 more escalate to user.
